entities.name: Query AdoMet decarboxylase
observations: 126 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 14.06 kDa and theoretical pI 5.14.
Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt B9E1Y4 from Clostridium kluyveri; identity and coverage are 100%, E-value 4.22e-90.
Contains the AdoMet_dc Pfam domain PF02675.23 spanning residues 6-113 with i-Evalue 7e-46.
Annotated as an S-adenosylmethionine decarboxylase proenzyme whose mature enzyme uses a covalent pyruvoyl group.
Catalyzes S-adenosyl-L-methionine decarboxylation to S-adenosylmethioninamine and CO2; EC 4.1.1.50, Rhea RHEA:15981.
Part of amine and polyamine biosynthesis, supplying the propylamine donor for spermidine and spermine synthesis; GO biological process GO:0008295.
Reference annotation describes a cytosolic heterotetramer composed of two alpha and two beta chains.

entities.name: AdoMet decarboxylation
observations: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + H+ -> S-adenosyl 3-(methylsulfanyl)propylamine + CO2; Rhea RHEA:15981 and EC 4.1.1.50.

entities.name: Polyamine biosynthesis
observations: S-adenosylmethionine decarboxylase performs the committed decarboxylation step producing decarboxylated AdoMet, the aminopropyl donor used in spermidine and spermine biosynthesis.
The referenced annotation assigns this activity to GO:0008295, spermidine biosynthetic process.
